 4. Counting rules: Total = number of active + number of retired; if the data contains a "Status" or "Type" field, "Active" includes records with the value "Active", and "Retired" includes records with the value "Retired"; if no such field exists, determine based on the column whose semantics most closely match "Active/Retired"

 6. Output as plain text
